context_summary: The paper proposes a case-based knowledge graph with reinforcement learning for intelligent design of complex products. It aims to address challenges in representing case knowledge and identifying key modification points in case reconstruction. The method integrates knowledge graphs and reinforcement learning to enhance design efficiency and product quality.
exclusion_facts: The paper does not collect human subjective evaluations, but rather focuses on algorithmic and computational methods.
